params.query: SELECT * FROM stats WHERE (StatVar IN ('dcid:Amount_Investment', 'dcid:Amount_Investment_EconomicAdjustmentAssistance', 'dcid:Amount_Investment_PublicWorks') OR StatVar IN ('Amount_Investment', 'Amount_Investment_EconomicAdjustmentAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_PublicWorks'))

rules.description: Checks that investment amounts are non-negative.
Checks that each StatVar has at least one observation.
